schema.description: Schema for a context of Google Analytics cookie values

description:
During today's analysis of the visitor’s analytics data, we captured the full set of Google Analytics cookies that identify the session and user attributes. The primary visitor identifier (__utma) returned the value **226872123.1499230774.1585450576.1585450576.1585450576.1**, while the session activity marker (__utmb) recorded **226872123.1.10.1585450576**. The domain reference cookie (__utmc) is simply **226872123**, and the custom variable cookie (__utmv) contains **226872123.|2=UserType=Guest**, indicating the visitor is classified as a Guest. Attribution details stored in the __utmz cookie are **226872123.1585450576.1.1.utmcsr=(direct)|utmccn=(direct)|utmcmd=(none)**, showing a direct traffic source with no campaign.

Additionally, the modern analytics identifier (_ga) was present with the value **GA1.2.1234567890.1585450576**, completing the snapshot of the cookie data for this session.
